$comment: Per-deployable overlay merged onto deploy/cloudflare/<deployable>/wrangler.jsonc by scripts/farm-config.mjs. Everything here is installation-specific (routes, addresses, ids of resources created in the account bass443 on 2026-09-06); the base configs stay free of it and keep placeholder ids. The generator itself adds vars.INSTALLATION and the apf:installation alias, so only what differs from the base belongs here. Arrays replace the base array whole, so a binding list must be complete.

$signingPublicKeys.$comment: Public keys of the gateway signing key(s). The private key lives only as the Worker secret GATEWAY_SIGNING_KEY (set 2026-09-06, never in a file). Hosts get this map as SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEYS when they are wired (unit D); rotation = new key id here + new secret.
